title: review-panel persona output
description: What every persona returns, and nothing else. The orchestrator merges these across personas.

checked.description: what this persona actually examined: files, laws, ADRs, call sites. Lets the report say what was covered.

cannot_verify.description: requirements or risks that cannot be judged from the diff alone; reported, never chased

confidence.description: 0 not confident (false positive) · 25 might be real · 50 real but minor · 75 real and important · 100 certain. Only >= 80 is reported.

sha.description: the head SHA the line numbers refer to

why.description: the failure it causes or the rule it breaks

fix.description: how to fix, only if not obvious

verified_by.description: the check that raised confidence: call sites read, test run, ADR quoted

pre_existing.description: true means the PR did not introduce it; such findings are omitted from the report

rule.description: for standards-and-invariants: the ADR id, doc path or epic decision violated, e.g. ADR-0007, CONTEXT.md#Invoice, epic:Implementation Decisions#3

advisories.description: not findings: candidate ADRs, terminology drift, rollout or monitoring notes for the Residual risk section
